name: Ashveil Ironmark Gang Colors Vest
description:
A sleeveless denim-analog vest in oxidized indigo, stiffened with resin-soaked salvage cloth backing. Hand-painted territorial sigils cover the rear panel — layered over years, each mark a palimpsest of alliances and victories. Chest patches are heat-bonded corponation logo inversions, deliberately defaced. Sleeve holes are raw-cut and re-hemmed with copper wire stitching.

Color saturation and patch density signal rank within the crew. A bare back means prospect. A fully covered back means you've bled for this block.
functionality: Reinforced rear panel provides minor impact absorption. Copper wire hem conducts static discharge in acid-rain conditions. Hidden interior pocket sewn beneath the left chest panel.
what_it_says: This person belongs to a specific block, has history with it, and will defend it.
story_hooks: A runner finds this vest on a body — the sigils match a crew that officially dissolved six years ago.
A Tier 3 fashion blogger is caught wearing a bootleg version; the original crew sends a message.
The vest's layered paint conceals a hand-drawn map of Shelf tunnel routes beneath the topmost sigil.
